page.layout: One printed page: title lines at the top in the centre, a woodcut vignette in the middle, imprint lines at the foot.

main_text.l: D. & Professore Theologiæ in Academia Leydensi.

page.notes: Engraved vignette in the centre (a wreath enclosing a hand with a pair of scales or a balance over a table); no text. Several lines, especially the top lines and the lines around "REFVTATIO", appear mirror-reversed; this is show-through from the other side of the leaf and is not transcribed as print. The date line "clɔ. Iↄ. Ic." is hard to read; it is most likely MDCIII, but it is not certain. Exact reading of the line "D. Theologiæ Societatis Iesu conscripta" is uncertain.
